entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Oh, hello? I... I think I need to return something. I'm just so confused by the website. I hope I'm in the right place.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Sarah. I can definitely help you with that. Can you tell me which item you're calling about today?
It's the... the helmet I ordered. It arrived a couple of weeks ago. I just... I don't think it's the right one for me. The color isn't what I expected from the pictures.
I understand completely. Getting the right color and fit is important, especially for safety equipment like a helmet. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.

Okay. I'm just so worried I missed the window or something. I didn't even take it out of the packaging, the box is unopened, I just peeked inside. Can't you just help me? The rules online were a bit overwhelming.

Of course, I can help. It's no problem at all. Let's see... okay, I've checked our policy and for a standard item like a helmet, you have a full 90 days from the delivery date to make a return. Since you received it 14 days ago, you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? Really? That's such a relief! I thought I only had a week or two.

Not at all. We want to ensure you're happy and confident in your gear. I'm processing the return for you now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the original box and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's so easy. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
Alright. Have a wonderful day and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
